title: HypeITA
description: QoL and more mods for Hypixel's Skyblock
body:
This modpack is a client-side package designed to improve the gameplay experience on Minecraft 1.21.10, with a focus on performance, visual quality, and advanced features for Hypixel SkyBlock.

It includes optimizations that increase FPS and reduce RAM usage, shader support compatible with Sodium, graphical enhancements, and numerous overlays and tools useful for SkyBlock.

It does not require server-side installation and is compatible with any vanilla or non-modded server.
